sources.description: One prospect the Denver Broncos are showing interest in and could be an option for them on day 3 of the draft is explosive TCU Linebacker Kaleb Elarms-Orr. They had him in for a pre-draft top-30 visit and also reportedly had a linebacker coach present for his Pro Day. He is a 6-2, 234-pound linebacker […]
